what was open: Spec 23.16 says bit-only weights below 5 bits replicate to a "5-bit value" but the target range is 0..63
chosen behaviour: replicate the n-bit value to 6 bits (also for 5-bit weights), then +1 if > 32
basis: section 23.16 first paragraph, range 0..63; example in the spec reads as a typo
status: confirmed bit-exact by astcenc black box (all bit-only weight ranges 1,3,7,15,31 occur in the vectors)

what was open: Whether alpha uses the 0x80 low byte in sRGB mode (23.18.1 says "each color component")
chosen behaviour: alpha is expanded like RGB: (C << 8) | 0x80, top 8 bits used directly
basis: literal reading of 23.18.1
status: confirmed by astcenc black box; replacing it by replication breaks the alpha_*_srgb vectors

what was open: Whether the decoder applies the sRGB EOTF (23.5: "converted with the sRGB EOTF")
chosen behaviour: no: RGB bytes are the stored sRGB-encoded values, the caller tags the colour space
basis: design note Q7b
status: confirmed against astcenc -ds output (no conversion); contract for ImageIO still a maintainer decision

what was open: 23.22 says extents "may not be checked", 23.23 lists min >= max as illegal
chosen behaviour: min >= max on s or t unless all four coordinates are all-ones gives the error colour; reserved bits 10 and 11 must be 1
basis: 23.23 list
status: confirmed by astcenc black box on random void blocks with invalid extents

what was open: HDR void-extent block in LDR mode
chosen behaviour: error colour, counted as an error block
basis: 23.22 last paragraphs

what was open: What error_block means when only an HDR partition is bad
chosen behaviour: set when at least one texel got the error colour, so partial blocks count
basis: 23.23 closing paragraph

what was open: Linear LDR mode vs HDR operation mode (23.5 allows promotion)
chosen behaviour: strict LDR: HDR endpoint modes (2,3,7,11,14,15) give magenta texels
status: matches astcenc -dl/-ds; HDR is out of scope

what was open: variable position directly below the weight data for extra CEM bits and CCS (23.9.2, 23.19)
chosen behaviour: extra CEM bits end where the weight bits begin, CCS sits directly below them, low-to-high in stream order
basis: Tables 165, 166 and the text
status: confirmed by astcenc black box (multi-partition mixed-class and dual-plane random blocks)

what was open: Table 161 text extraction lost bit widths
chosen behaviour: widths read from the colspan attributes of the HTML table
basis: HTML of the Khronos document
status: count of valid, void and reserved modes (1872, 4, 172) re-derived independently and tested

what was open: Bits past the end of a sequence
chosen behaviour: read as zero, for colour data as well as weights
basis: 23.12: "unused (higher-order) bits are assumed to be 0"
status: confirmed by vectors (partial trit/quint blocks occur)

what was open: >> on negative ints in blue_contract and bit_transfer_signed
chosen behaviour: arithmetic shift (implementation-defined in C99, defined on gcc, clang, MSVC)
basis: spec pseudo-code is C

what was open: Weight index past the grid edge in decode_weight(v0 + Wwidth + 1)
chosen behaviour: read as 0
basis: spec silent; the interpolation weight of such a corner is 0 for every legal footprint (checked by hand for 4,5,6,8,10,12)

what was open: Footprint not in table 155 passed to the decoder
chosen behaviour: DTC_E_ARG
basis: 23.8: other sizes are not supported

what was open: Payload longer than the block count needs
chosen behaviour: accepted, trailing bytes ignored
basis: .astc files may carry nothing extra, but callers may pass a larger buffer

what was open: Payload shorter than the block count needs
chosen behaviour: DTC_E_TRUNCATED, nothing decoded
basis: design 4.4 error model

what was open: Output size limit
chosen behaviour: none besides width*height*4 fitting size_t (DTC_E_OVERFLOW)
basis: design 11.4 suggests a 16384 cap (its guess G14); a cap needs a caller who wants one

what was open: Texels beyond the image edge in partial blocks
chosen behaviour: decoded but not written
basis: 23.8: those texels may be any colour

what was open: .astc header with a footprint in no table, zero dimension or wrong magic
chosen behaviour: DTC_E_CORRUPT; a valid 3D footprint or depth > 1 parses and the 2D variant answers DTC_E_UNSUPPORTED
basis: FileFormat description of the container

what was open: SPDX identifier in the sources
chosen behaviour: GPL-3.0-only
basis: Darling LICENSE is "GNU GPL 3.0"; "or later" is not stated

what was open: The .astc container has no transfer function and no public ImageIO page says what colour space an ASTC image has
chosen behaviour: sRGB colour space (kCGColorSpaceSRGB); the stored RGB bytes are taken as sRGB-encoded, which is the decoder's sRGB operation mode (G3)
basis: conservative: matches the sRGB decode mode, no transfer function applied

what was open: Straight or premultiplied alpha is not documented for ASTC
chosen behaviour: straight alpha (kCGImageAlphaLast), RGBA8, 32 bits per pixel, as the decoder returns it
basis: ASTC stores straight alpha (KDFS 23.18.1); converting would lose precision

what was open: No uniform type identifier for ASTC appears in the public UTType or ImageIO documentation
chosen behaviour: the source reports no type (CGImageSourceGetType returns NULL) and CGImageSourceCopyTypeIdentifiers does not list one; data is recognised by its magic number
basis: an identifier is not invented; the documented NULL is for a source whose container is not recognised
status: open; design Q3 (a human with a Mac can print the real value)

what was open: Per-block corruption: show the error colour or fail?
chosen behaviour: an image with any error block (illegal block, HDR endpoint mode in LDR decoding) yields no image (NULL); no partial magenta image
basis: fail loud; an encoder never writes an error block (G6)

what was open: No size cap is documented
chosen behaviour: no image above 16384 texels on a side or 2^26 texels in total (256 MiB of RGBA8), and none when the payload holds fewer blocks than the header needs; all checked before allocating
basis: design 11.4 suggests 16384; the PSD source uses the same pixel cap

what was open: Source and image status for bad .astc data, source properties, type-hint option
chosen behaviour: a source exists when the magic number matches; a truncated, oversized, illegal-block, 3D or bad-footprint file gives a source with a NULL image (see I7); data without the magic number gives no source and goes on to the Onyx2D decoders; the only properties are PixelWidth and PixelHeight; kCGImageSourceTypeIdentifierHint is ignored
basis: public text only says NULL on error

what was open: Status of a source whose data has the magic number but does not decode
chosen behaviour: count 0, like the PSD source, and CGImageSourceGetStatus reports kCGImageStatusInvalidData for any source whose count is 0 (this also applies to the other formats; a valid source has count >= 1)
basis: complete would claim an image that cannot be made; the public text only says NULL on error
status: not observed on macOS; design Q10
